n: MIT Computational Action AI Generated Art lesson
t: A 90 minute lesson on GAN art and who owns art made with AI.
steps: Find the lesson on the MIT Computational Action site.
Copy the script and the slide decks.
Open Google Chrome on student devices.
Try the Art or Not activity yourself.
Try the GANs Art web tools.
Check whether any tool needs an account.
Plan the three parts of 1 hour, 15 minutes, and 20 minutes.
